entities.summary: Anriel Howard is an American professional wrestler. As of December 2020, she is signed to WWE, where she performs on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Lash Legend. She is one-half of the current WWE Women's Tag Team Champions with Nia Jax as The Irresistible Forces in their first reign as a team. Individually, it is Legend's first reign.
